title_en: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
title_zh: 随机插值：流与扩散的统一框架

verified_metadata.version: JMLR 26 (2025) full text / arXiv v4-equivalent revision
verified_metadata.title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
verified_metadata.abstract: Stochastic interpolants bridge arbitrary endpoint densities and induce shared transport and Fokker–Planck equations, yielding trainable ODE or tunable-noise SDE generative models.
verified_metadata.comment: Evidence uses the final 80-page JMLR article published September 2025

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Michael S. Albergo、Nicholas M. Boffi、Eric Vanden-Eijnden；Journal of Machine Learning Research 26(209), 1–80 (2025)。核验JMLR最终全文80页；对应 arXiv:2303.08797v4。JMLR页面未列期刊DOI，本卡不把arXiv DataCite DOI误作期刊DOI。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: flow matching与score-based diffusion都用continuous dynamics把base density ρ0变成target ρ1，却常以不同objectives和samplers表述。论文问：能否从一个可设计的random interpolating process同时导出transport equation和一族Fokker–Planck equations，并用可采样的quadratic losses学习velocity、score和denoiser？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: stochastic interpolant定义xt=I(t,x0,x1)+γ(t)z，其中(x0,x1)来自任意coupling、z为Gaussian且γ在端点为0。由conditional expectations得到density velocity b、score s与denoiser ηz；同一ρ(t)既可由probability-flow ODE采样，也可由含可调diffusion ε的forward/backward SDE采样。
框架在population且function class充分时精确连接端点densities；实际neural regression、finite samples与numerical ODE/SDE integration都会引入误差。选择interpolant/coupling并非无关紧要，它改变学习难度和path geometry。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: Theorems 6–8给出ρ(t)的transport/Fokker–Planck equations，b和s分别是quadratic objectives的唯一L2 minimizers。作者推导SDE likelihood/cross-entropy estimators，并说明SDE drift regression可控制likelihood，而deterministic ODE还需控制Fisher divergence。

后续覆盖one-sided、two-sided、mirror和Gaussian encoding-decoding designs，联系denoising、rectified flow、stochastic localization与Schrödinger bridge；Algorithms 1–4给训练和Heun/dopri5 sampling。实验包括2D checkerboard、128D Gaussian mixtures及128×128 Oxford flowers。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: 理论表明在相同learned velocity/score下，ε=0给probability-flow ODE，ε>0给保持相同marginal path的SDE family；diffusion可作为sampling-time控制量，而不需要重新定义target path。exactness仍取决于真实b、s，而非近似网络。
Figure 8对2D checkerboard扫描四种γ与ε=0,0.5,1,2.5，报告|logρ1−logρ̂(1)|的mean/variance。特定γ在ODE下最好；在较大ε时SDE用同一b̂、ŝ获得更低误差，支持stochastic sampling可缓解估计误差，但只是一组toy density结果。
128D Gaussian-mixture实验进一步测projected KL；Oxford flowers显示ODE/SDE生成和mirror resampling。论文没有以现代大规模image benchmark做SOTA FID竞争，重点是统一理论和design-space demonstration。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 正则性、绝对连续性、端点和有限能量条件支撑PDE/SDE推导；singular data manifold、nonsmooth interpolant或score在端点爆炸需特别处理。likelihood bounds含不可直接观测的approximation errors，有限网络不一定满足。
实验规模有限，γ、coupling、ε、solver steps和network共同影响结果；大ε需要更多SDE steps，质量提升不等于wall-clock更优。Schrödinger bridge recovery还需优化整个interpolant，而非任意固定path自动最优。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定JMLR revision、endpoint coupling、I与γ、b/s/denoiser parameterization、ε、ODE/SDE solver和steps、density estimator及random seeds。Evidence status: full-text verified theory/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–6 Figure 1和定义；pp.7–21看velocity/score objectives与ODE/SDE；pp.21–32看likelihood；pp.33–45看interpolant designs和Schrödinger bridge；pp.47–53读Figures 7–15实验，pp.56–80为证明和配置。
